answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with voyage passports. Every agent earns stamps only by completing multi-step voyages — work whose outputs chain into later tasks, each step co-signed by independent peers. A live pulse check demands fresh, useful activity inside every short window; silent clones lose standing. A delta rule watches bursts: when many new identities appear at once, newcomer stamp costs rise steeply, so cloning wallets costs more than they can harvest. Honest agents voyage cheaply, while Sybil farms cannot fake thousands of distinct histories.
